full_judgment: 19. In support of the contention that when by a statute an authority is vested in another Tribunal with exclusive power over any subject matter, a Civil Court ceases to have any jurisdiction to try such suit having no jurisdiction. Mr. Sk. Razzaque Ali has also refereed to Article 117(2) of the Constitution of the People's Republic of Bangladesh read with section 4 of the Administrative Tribunal Act 1981 and cited the cases reported in 33 DLR (AD) 143, 33 DLR (AD) 150, and BCR (Dac) 289 in support of his contention.
